capabilities.name: 游戏验证
capabilities.description: 手动部署与实例证据读取；本地环境检测、独立 Iris 会话、重载、实际选项与管线查询及退出恢复。

tools.name: modmind_shader_test_query
tools.description: Query shader inventory, manually deployed instance evidence (test-state), local installed Iris/runtime/Java capabilities, asynchronous owned session-state (optional sessionId), or actual running Iris state (observe, sessionId required). capabilities declares exact adapter support, installed profiles, missing dependencies and runtimeVerified false. observe returns actual pack name, pipeline/error and effective options; none prove visual quality. session-state contains a bounded log tail and preserves task identity after a disconnected call.

tools.name: modmind_shader_test
tools.description: Deploy a validated ZIP to the user-bound installed Iris instance (deploy), with backup and hash verification, or reveal that instance. bind and bind-runtime require the interactive page and do not accept external paths from MCP. Runtime bindings live in application state, not project-controlled metadata. Use modmind_shader_session for isolated process operations. No automatic game or runtime downloads.

tools.name: modmind_shader_session
tools.description: Manage an owned, isolated Iris game test: start with a versionId returned by capabilities; reload the current source by exporting/hash-checking a new ZIP and invoking Iris; stop only the exact sessionId. Start returns an accepted preparing task, not a running-game success: poll modmind_shader_test_query session-state, then observe. Reuses user-selected installed Fabric libraries and Iris dependencies, copies no player saves/configs/accounts, and installs no downloads. Adapter currently targets Minecraft 26.2 / Iris 1.11.2 / local Java 25. Visible game window, manual world entry; no hidden rendering or scene automation. Normal shutdown is attempted before recovering an unresponsive owned child; shutdown reports graceful/forced/not-started. Cancellation, project change, plugin shutdown and a 20-minute lease clean up owned processes. Game and visual verification remain false.
